contract: Data and group offsets staged by one producer epoch stay hidden until that epoch commits. An abort hides both.
A later committed epoch of the same producer publishes its own data and offset.
A lower group generation than one already staged stores nothing. An empty member id stores nothing. An older producer epoch stores nothing.
Repeating the same commit marker does not append another record. Reopen shows the committed offset and data and still hides the aborted id.
limits: This is not the transactional OffsetCommit RPC and it does not consult a live group coordinator.
The generation fence is the highest generation already staged in this log. Member metadata is a nonempty member id stored with the offset.
The journal format is the local PLTXNO01 record.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
